'''Ression Trana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan leader who lived during [[Great Hunt (Defenestrator)|one]] of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunts]], Mandalorian contests of skill and glory. When an [[Defenestrator|obsolete construction droid]] emerged victorious, Trana objected to the idea of declaring the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt|Grand Champion]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and proceeded to rant about how the droid mocked Mandalorian traditions. However, when Trana accused the droid of being a proxy for a cowardly contestant,<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|Galactic History 88: The Unlikely Champion}}</ref> thereby questioning the droid's honor, the droid immediately kicked Trana<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> mid-sentence through<ref name="Codex" /> a fifteenth-story window. After a moment of silence, the other Mandalorians unanimously declared the droid Grand Champion, and also christened it "the Defenestrator."<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
